Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Kulkarni,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 September 2025 about your dispute with Meera Bansal. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Lucknow.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
